description: Add a new memory to the persistent store. Supports 4 cognitive layers: episodic (events/sessions), semantic (facts/concepts), procedural (rules/workflows), resource (reference material). Automatically supersedes previous entries from the same source_file.

confidence.description: How certain this memory is (0.0–1.0, default 0.8)

event_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the event occurred (episodic layer)

layer.description: Cognitive layer: episodic=events/sessions, semantic=facts/concepts, procedural=rules/workflows, resource=reference material

session_id.description: Session ID for grouping episodic memories

title.description: Optional short title for the memory

ttl_days.description: Days until this memory expires (null = never)

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 date when this fact becomes valid (null = always valid)

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 date when this fact stops being valid (null = no end date)

name: memory_add
